mentions.name: bookclub.cloud
mentions.description: A web tool that leverages DRM-free epubs to help manage book clubs. It provides word counts per reading, chapter selection, the ability to highlight and share sections, and AI-powered summarization plus spoiler-free discussion about a given reading. The author is building infrastructure for running clubs and plans an agent that prompts readers and clubs with questions to encourage deeper critical analysis while reading.
mentions.problem: Managing book club readings from DRM-free epubs is cumbersome, and DRM-free requirements make the app hard to monetize due to a high barrier for non-technical users.
mentions.audience: A non-technical readership in book clubs; the author notes the DRM-free epub requirement is a high barrier for most non-technical users.
